name: Moab
description: Moabite living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day. And the younger bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

note.label: The Madmen Of China And Their Hatred For Black People

points: The firstborn bare Moab, father of the Moabites, and the younger bare Benammi, father of the Ammonites, unto this day. In this teaching those nations are identified with the peoples known today as the Chinese and the Japanese.
